scenes.conflict: Her fear that concessions will set a precedent delays a decision, while Tomas warns that continued rationing without a clear accounting will undermine trust.
scenes.goal: Mara aims to protect the ring's independence while finding a defensible way to keep its water and filters functioning.
scenes.outcome: Mara agrees to examine the allocation records before answering the Shipwardens, but does not yet grant access.
scenes.summary: In Seventh Habitat, Mara reviews the ring's tightening reserves with Tomas. A Shipwarden request for the water records sharpens the council's split between defending independence and preventing a shortage.
scenes.title: The Cost of Separation

scenes.conflict: Ilan doubts her interpretation and wants the evidence contained; Mara fears uncertain claims will weaken the council's negotiating position.
scenes.goal: Seli wants both authorities to authorize a safe investigation toward the shared machinery.
scenes.outcome: Mara and Ilan refuse immediate access, but agree to review the rhythm again if Seli can provide a verifiable pattern.
scenes.summary: At Crown Lift Junction, Seli demonstrates a repeating vibration to Mara and Ilan. It differs from familiar pump and bearing patterns, but Seli cannot yet prove its source.
scenes.title: A Pattern in the Ribs

scenes.conflict: He treats responsibility for shared systems as authority to command, overlooking the charter's promise of each ring's voice.
scenes.goal: Ilan seeks to secure Shipwarden access to the Core Exchange and the ring's maintenance controls.
scenes.outcome: Ilan sends a formal request for inspection and warns that delay leaves the shared machinery without adequate oversight.
scenes.summary: At Core Exchange, Ilan receives the council's refusal to open the route and prepares a renewed demand for inspection rights over the isolated systems.
scenes.title: Inspection Rights

scenes.conflict: He is inclined to publish every figure, while Mara worries the reserve's disclosure will become leverage for Shipwarden control.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants a ration plan that residents can audit without putting essential technicians at risk.
scenes.outcome: They prepare a verified summary, but Mara postpones sharing it until she can negotiate safeguards.
scenes.summary: In Water Ledger Hall, Tomas shows Mara the allocation records, including a protected reserve for the technicians maintaining the ring's filters and circulation.
scenes.title: What the Ledger Hides

scenes.conflict: Her caution about the uncertain source makes her reluctant to reveal the full pattern, while Ilan suspects the investigation could be used to justify an unauthorized entry.
scenes.goal: Seli aims to earn permission for a listener team to trace the rhythm toward the shared machinery.
scenes.outcome: Seli shares the full sequence and its limits; Ilan agrees to consider a supervised test, and Mara agrees to hear a corridor proposal.
scenes.summary: Seli returns to Crown Lift Junction with a repeatable sequence, comparing it against known machinery patterns. She can establish that it is unusual, but not what is producing it.
scenes.title: The Rhythm Repeats

scenes.conflict: Mara's delay has left residents without an explanation, and Tomas fears that partial disclosure will look like favoritism.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants Mara to approve a transparent ration plan that protects the technicians' reserve and reduces overall use.
scenes.outcome: Mara approves a limited ration adjustment and an audited summary, making joint review necessary if the Shipwardens are to verify the ring's figures.
scenes.summary: Back in Water Ledger Hall, Tomas compares current allocations with the ring's reserves and explains that maintaining the existing rate will leave too little margin for system upkeep.
scenes.title: A Tighter Ration

scenes.conflict: Ilan's demand for broad inspection rights and Mara's insistence that every concession be temporary threaten to end talks.
scenes.goal: Mara seeks a limited route that preserves the council's declaration, while Ilan seeks reliable access to shared machinery.
scenes.outcome: They agree to a single monitored entry and a joint review of the verified water summary, but leave the terms of lasting oversight unresolved.
scenes.summary: At Crown Lift Junction, Mara and Ilan negotiate a narrow, jointly monitored maintenance corridor toward Core Exchange, with Seli's team tracing the unusual rhythm under supervision.
scenes.title: A Route With Conditions

scenes.conflict: The route is narrow and the machinery serves every ring; Ilan wants to take command, while Seli cannot yet distinguish a source from a transmitted pattern.
scenes.goal: The team aims to locate the rhythm's source and determine whether it signals a risk to the ship's circulation systems.
scenes.outcome: Seli identifies a repeating vibration near a circulation pump, and Ilan's readings show an irregularity worth investigating; they agree not to alter the system until they can verify the cause.
scenes.summary: The group uses the agreed maintenance route to reach Core Exchange. Seli follows the rhythm through the structural ribs while Ilan checks the machinery and Mara observes the shared procedure.
scenes.title: Into Shared Machinery

scenes.conflict: Ilan's instinct is to take control of the system, but he lacks Seli's trained reading; Seli's fear of being discredited tempts her to overstate what the rhythm proves.
scenes.goal: The team seeks to verify whether the vibration corresponds to a machinery fault and choose a safe next step.
scenes.outcome: They confirm that the vibration tracks an irregular pump cycle, without claiming to know its full cause. Ilan accepts a jointly monitored inspection instead of unilateral control.
scenes.summary: At Core Exchange, Seli compares the rhythm with Ilan's pump readings, while Mara asks both to state what they know and what remains uncertain before anyone acts.
scenes.title: Evidence, Not Orders

scenes.conflict: Mara fears that an open-ended corridor will erase self-rule, while Ilan fears that limited access will leave other rings exposed to local decisions.
scenes.goal: Mara seeks to keep the independence declaration in force while securing cooperation; Ilan seeks enforceable safeguards for shared life support.
scenes.outcome: They agree to a narrowly monitored maintenance corridor governed by joint review, and Mara submits the verified water summary for shared scrutiny without relinquishing the council's authority over local allocation.
scenes.summary: At Crown Lift Junction, Mara and Ilan present the verified finding and negotiate the route's future while Seli distinguishes observed evidence from unanswered questions.
scenes.title: A Corridor by Consent

scenes.conflict: Residents need a credible account of scarcity, but exposing raw figures without context could put technicians under pressure and invite political blame.
scenes.goal: Tomas aims to make rationing traceable while protecting the people needed to maintain the ring's filters and circulation.
scenes.outcome: Mara and Ilan accept the verified summary and a regular joint review, giving both authorities a shared basis for responding to shortages.
scenes.summary: In Water Ledger Hall, Tomas presents the verified allocation summary and explains the technicians' reserve and its review process to Mara and Ilan.
scenes.title: The Accountable Reserve

scenes.conflict: Hardliners see any route as surrender, while residents need to know that water decisions and maintenance obligations will remain accountable.
scenes.goal: Mara seeks council backing for a practical charter proposal that protects local decision-making and sustains shared maintenance.
scenes.outcome: The council adopts the monitored corridor and joint water review as a practical proposal under its independence claim; Mara and Ilan leave with cooperation established but sovereignty still to be negotiated.
scenes.summary: In Seventh Habitat, Mara brings the corridor terms and water review process to the council. Ilan's acceptance of joint safeguards allows her to argue that cooperation need not revoke independence.
scenes.title: Cooperation Chosen

logline: As dwindling water reserves and an unexplained rhythm threaten an isolated generation-ship ring, its negotiator and a Shipwarden must decide whether to reopen a contested route without surrendering the ring's claim to self-rule.
theme: Cooperation can preserve self-rule when authority is shared and accountable.
title: Ring Seven
